content.title: 不定式 to do 作宾语 / 宾补 / 状语 / 定语 速查
content.intro: 不定式 to do 在句中能当宾语、宾语补足语、状语和定语。判断口诀:看它跟在谁后面、补充说明谁、或修饰前面哪个名词。特别小心使役/感官动词后宾补「不带 to」。

rows: want/decide/hope/plan/refuse/manage + to do:He decided to focus on the details.
know/wonder/decide + how/what/where/whether to do:She wondered how to dress.
ask/tell/want/allow/encourage sb to do:The teacher advised me to go.
make/let/have + sb do;hear/watch/feel/see sb do:I heard him sing.
(in order)/(so as) to do 表目的;…only to do 表结果:Painters use brushes to create effects.
the first/best + to do;a way/time/chance to do;sth to do:the first songwriter to win it.

specialRules.rule: 使役动词 make / let / have 后,宾补用动词原形(不带 to)
specialRules.mark: make sb do √ / make sb to do ×

specialRules.rule: 感官动词 hear / watch / feel / see 后,宾补也用原形(不带 to)
make/hear 等变被动后,to 要还原
specialRules.mark: He was made to wait.(主动 make sb do → 被动 be made to do)

specialRules.rule: 序数词、形容词最高级、the only/last 后常用 to do 作定语

why: 不定式表示「将要、目的或一次性的动作」,所以在「打算做/为了做/要去做的事物」这些场合自然出现;而使役/感官动词本身已含动作意味,后面只需原形动词补充宾语在做什么,故省去 to。
gaokaoPoints: to do 与 doing 的区分(decide to do vs enjoy doing);疑问词+to do 高频。
make/let/have/hear/watch + sb do 的「不带 to」考点;变被动时 to 回来。
the first/best/only + to do、a way/chance to do 作定语,语法填空常考。

examVsReal.exam: I heard him sing a song.(考试:hear sb do)
examVsReal.real: I heard him singing a song.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考原形 do(听到全过程);真实口语里 doing 表示「听到正在唱」,两者侧重不同。

examVsReal.exam: the first person to do it（考试用 to do 定语）
examVsReal.real: the first person who did it
examVsReal.note: 考试偏好不定式定语;口语常用定语从句,意思相同。
